scope: Visual inspection of every full-page English manuscript PNG from pages 21 through 39; no scientific reanalysis
inspection_method: Each page was opened with tools.view_image using original detail; contact sheets were not substituted for full-page inspection.

nonblocking_observations.observation: The Table 2 explanatory note continues onto page 27; the table body and all rows remain together and complete on page 26.

focused_checks.figure_3_page_23: Both panels, all model labels, legend and complete caption are visible and readable on the same page; no overlap or cropping observed.
focused_checks.figure_4_page_25: All 80 heatmap cells are visible; 34 numeric differences and crossed undefined cells are distinct. The color scale, defined counts, strict-macro NA statement, external points, intervals and sample counts are readable. The full caption is on the same page with no overlap or cropping.
focused_checks.table_2_page_26: All drug rows and equal-drug macro are visible. Exact-zero external rows read as identical predictions and are distinct from the nonzero macro. Header and numeric cells are not clipped.
focused_checks.references_pages_34_through_38: All 31 numbered references are present in the visually inspected sequence. Author lists, et al text, journal formatting and DOI strings render without missing-glyph boxes or right-edge clipping; this visual check is not a new bibliographic metadata verification.
focused_checks.supplement_descriptions_pages_38_and_39: Additional-file descriptions are readable and complete through Additional file 14.
focused_checks.body_pages_21_through_39: No text collisions, clipped text, blank unexpected pages, missing-glyph boxes, missing page numbers or detached section headings observed. Normal paragraph continuation across pages remains readable.
